## Before you start

Prepare the batch and load its context as shown in [Prepare the export](01_prepare_export.html#public-api).
Set `observe_trip_source` to `observe-main.public-api` in `export-runner.yaml`.

## Select and extract trips

Use the prepared context to select trip IDs and extract their tables through the public API.

```{r extract-trip-sources, eval=FALSE}
# Save the selected trip IDs, source CSVs and typed tables.
batch_sources <- ros.form.observe::extract_export_sources(export_context)
```

Find `selected-trip-ids.csv` in `sources/`. Each trip has its own CSV directory and a matching `.Rds` under `sources/trips/`.
